wholePhysicalScope: The native named precinct, stupa footprint, mapped hall roofs and the label points for the museum and Jade Hall establish the standing site. The larger east-facing hall beside the stupa matches the official three-by-five-bay ordination hall. The separate distant generic chapel label was excluded.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the tiered timber temple roofs, gilded Phra Chedi and separate native footprints.
limitations: Current temple exteriors are represented. The present ordination hall was remodeled in 1960 and its gable finial was mounted in 2007. This is not the 1940s temple form.
The native stupa outline and four named or contextually identified footprints are fixed. Minor span, floor heights, tile shades, Jade Hall trim and individual sculpture are simplified or approximate.
Original local relief is retained. Grounds, minor buildings and museum and worship interiors are outside the authored scope.
